description: This file implements pager functionality for a Git-like application, managing external pager processes, terminal size detection, environment setup, and configuration handling.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to finish, restores original file descriptors, and updates environment.

methods.name: wait_for_pager_signal
methods.description: Handles signals to terminate the pager process safely.

methods.name: core_pager_config
methods.description: Configures the pager program based on git configuration.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Determines the pager command to use based on environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: setup_pager_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables for the pager process.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares arguments for spawning the pager process.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Initializes and spawns the pager process, redirecting output and setting environment variables.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks if the pager is currently in use.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Calculates the number of terminal columns, using environment variables or ioctl.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Calculates the width needed to display a number in decimal.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Checks pager configuration for a specific command.
